what: Replace llm-core in the prismis daemon with the official openai Python SDK, called directly: one small module owning complete(), a services.toml reader, an apiconf key fetch and a JSON extractor; every call site repointed; llm-core removed from prismis.
why: Cost tracking is silently broken: llm-core estimates cost from a static pricing table that has no entry for four of the six prismis services, so cost_usd is null for every OpenRouter call, and refreshing the table cannot fix it (docs/work/wo-openai-sdk-migration.md, Why). The provider already returns billed cost when asked. All six prismis services speak one wire format (openai adapter; api.openai.com or openrouter.ai as base_url). The design, the rejected alternatives (tau, litellm, keeping llm-core) and D-TEMP are settled in docs/work/wo-openai-sdk-migration.md and are not re-opened here.

outOfScope: Deleting llm-core from the machine or changing services.toml: eight other apps depend on both
Re-opening the SDK choice, D-TEMP, or the rejected alternatives
Splitting the summarizer prompt (gh #79), content-kind classification (gh #77), tool extraction (gh #78)
Restoring the credential-gated live-LLM tests beyond SC-3's own (gh #60)
stakes: Bad output still looks like output. The wrapper must raise the SDK's typed exceptions, never catch and return empty text; a JSON failure must be logged, never swallowed into a stored summary.

Use the sync OpenAI client, not AsyncOpenAI (F-ASYNC in the markdown work order): the API handlers call the LLM synchronously inside the event loop and the orchestrator runs on APScheduler's threadpool.
The circuit breaker stays and should classify the SDK's typed exceptions (RateLimitError, APIStatusError status 429/402) rather than only substring-matching str(error).

The public result shape stays llm-core's (text, model, provider, tokens.input, tokens.output, finish_reason, duration_ms, cost). Config keys llm.light_service / llm.deep_service keep working unchanged.

Tests run in public CI with no credentials and no network: LLM calls go to a local stub HTTP server (daemon/tests/conftest.py local_pipeline_stub / configure_local_services already write services.toml under the sealed XDG_CONFIG_HOME). Only SC-3 is live, gated on PRISMIS_LIVE_LLM_TESTS, skipped in CI.

Patching prismis internals is forbidden and guarded (tests/unit/test_no_internal_mocks_unit.py). Its allowlist names complete and health_check; if the new module's functions are renamed, the allowlist follows by decision, not by loosening.

test_dual_service_config_unit and test_llm_core_migration_unit carry tests that only assert the setup wizard writes services.toml/pricing.toml; give each a deliberate disposition. INV-003 (the service -> light_service rename) is unrelated to llm-core and must survive.
daemon/scripts/model_playtest.py is tracked now (808c86e) and runs the real summarize/evaluate path; it must keep working after the swap.
mypy is the gate's typechecker; the llm_core entries in both pyproject [[tool.mypy.overrides]] go, and the new module type-checks without new ignores.
Every new or rewritten test must be shown to fail with the behaviour it covers removed (CLAUDE.md Learned Patterns).
